title: Ranking quality telemetry backfill and AB experiment hooks for reranking endpoint
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Improve reranking quality observability and enable AB experiments by backfilling historical NDCG/MRR per-customer promptset, adding lightweight per-request metric attribution, and exposing experiment hooks in the rerank endpoint. Scope includes data pipeline backfill, small runtime instrumentation changes to attach eval tags to requests, dashboards/alerts, and an experiment SDK hook for the control/treatment routing used by the console and integration tests.

Why: Product teams need to detect regressions in reranking quality when making embedding/model/quantization changes and to measure impact of routing and batching changes on both quality (NDCG/MRR) and latency. Existing eval runs live outside of request telemetry and are not consistently attributable to customer promptset variants.

Out of scope: Full retraining of reranker models, large-scale model selection UI in console, major KV cache redesign.

Deliverables: backfilled metric table for NDCG/MRR by customer and promptset variant, rerank endpoint header/tagging for experiment ids, updated dashboards with per-variant NDCG/MRR and p90/p99 latency, an SDK hook for canary/AB routing, and rollout playbook with safeguards.
acceptance_criteria: Historical NDCG and MRR backfilled for the last 90 days with mapping to customer promptset ids and variant tags
Rerank endpoint attaches experiment_id and promptset_variant metadata to telemetry events without adding >2ms median latency
Dashboards show per-customer and per-variant NDCG/MRR trends with exportable CSVs
A/B experiment SDK allows routing decisions to be made deterministically per-request and emits experiment.assignment events
Integration tests that simulate 3 customer promptset variants complete in CI and validate metric attribution
Rollout plan and rollback knobs documented in the ticket and reviewed by SRE and PM
implementation_notes: Backfill: build a nightly Spark job that replays stored evaluation records and re-computes NDCG@10 and MRR@10 using current metric code path; join against customer promptset registry to tag variants
Telemetry: add optional X-Rerank-Experiment and X-Promptset-Variant HTTP headers to rerank API; server will pass fields into our event-emitter pipeline as dimension tags
Performance: measure header parsing overhead in canary; if >2ms median, move to a binary header or pre-parsed context used by runtime thread-local cache
A/B SDK: deterministic hashing based on customer id + request id + experiment salt; support forced assignment via header for QA
Privacy: strip PII from promptset names before storing in metrics; store only stable promptset ids and anonymized names
Data retention: backfilled metrics follow current eval retention (180 days) and can be exported for offline analysis
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Canary): deploy telemetry header parsing to 5% traffic for internal and a small subset of beta customers; verify no increased error rates
Phase 2 (Backfill): run backfill job on staging and validate counts/deltas against historical eval outputs; run sampling validation with PM
Phase 3 (Wide): enable headers for 100% of hosted rerank traffic and turn on dashboards; enable SDK hooks for console-driven experiments
Rollback: ability to drop telemetry tags at ingest layer; feature-flag AB SDK routing to revert deterministic assignments
Communication: notify SRE, PM, DS and Customer Success before Phase 2 and 3 with expected query load and storage growth

Integration test that sends synthetic requests with X-Rerank-Experiment and X-Promptset-Variant headers and asserts emitted telemetry contains expected tags
Load test for header parsing path at 10k rps to validate CPU overhead and tail latency
Backfill validation script that compares aggregated backfilled metrics to historical eval harness outputs with tolerance thresholds
